headline: A previously unknown actor ran SonicWall SMA VPN appliances as root-granting zero-days for nearly a month before disclosure, as Russia's Sandworm aimed fake CAPTCHAs at Ukraine.

emerging_trends.text: Enterprise VPN gateways remain the softest way in: a previously unknown crew ran SonicWall SMA appliances as root-granting zero-days for nearly a month before anyone disclosed the bugs, and the Inc ransomware gang piled on.
emerging_trends.topic_title: SonicWall SMA Zero-Days Exploited as Root

emerging_trends.text: State hackers keep leaning on the victim's own hands as Russia's Sandworm dresses malware installs up as human-verification checks, pushing ClickFix lures onto Ukrainian machines.
Trusted update channels are becoming attack surface, as an advanced actor hijacks ViPNet's software-update mechanism to slip malware into Russian government agencies.

topics.title: SonicWall SMA Zero-Days Exploited as Root
topics.latest_developments: Volexity tied the pre-disclosure exploitation to a previously undocumented actor it tracks as UTA0533, which has hit SonicWall Secure Mobile Access 1000 appliances as zero-days since June 22, 2026, weeks before the flaws went public.
topics.summary: Two chained SMA 1000 flaws hand attackers root-level control of the VPN gateways, and the Inc ransomware crew already weaponized the chain. Administrators running SonicWall Secure Mobile Access should patch and hunt for compromise now.

sources.title: SonicWall SMA Zero-Days Exploited Before Disclosure to Gain Root Access
Inc Ransomware Exploits SonicWall SMA Zero-Days

topics.title: Sandworm Turns ClickFix on Ukraine
topics.latest_developments: Ukraine's CERT-UA attributed a fresh ClickFix campaign to UAC-0145, a sub-cluster of GRU-linked Sandworm, which tricks Ukrainian users through fake CAPTCHA prompts into running data-stealing malware on their own machines.
topics.summary: ClickFix lures instruct victims to paste and run a command disguised as a human-verification check. Sandworm, the hacking unit of Russia's GRU military intelligence, now points the technique at Ukrainian devices.

sources.title: UAC-0145 Uses ClickFix CAPTCHAs to Infect Ukrainian Devices with Malware

topics.title: ViPNet Update Channel Subverted
topics.latest_developments: BleepingComputer reported July 19, 2026 that an advanced threat actor is subverting the update mechanism of the ViPNet secure-networking suite to plant malware on Russian organizations, including government agencies.
topics.summary: ViPNet secures private networks across Russian government and enterprise. The actor hijacks its trusted software-update channel to reach agency systems that the product is meant to protect.

sources.title: Hackers abuse ViPNet software to target Russian govt agencies

topics.title: 7-Zip Patches Archive RCE
topics.latest_developments: 7-Zip shipped version 26.02 on July 18, 2026 to fix a remote code execution flaw that fires when a user opens a specially crafted compressed archive.
topics.summary: The bug lets attackers run code by persuading a victim to open a malicious archive in the widely used 7-Zip utility. Users should update to 26.02.

sources.title: Update now: 7-Zip fixes RCE flaw exploitable with malicious archives

business_politics.title: U.S. Strikes Iran After Troops Die in Jordan
business_politics.latest_developments: An Iranian ballistic-missile attack in Jordan killed two U.S. service members and left one missing, and U.S. Central Command answered with fresh strikes to "swiftly punish" Iran as Israel warned that Tehran's fire is landing close.
business_politics.summary: The month-old interim deal meant to end the U.S.-Iran war has crumbled, and American and Iranian forces trade strikes across the region while Iran begins hitting U.S. Gulf allies, keeping oil markets on edge.

sources.title: Two U.S. Troops Were Killed, One Is Missing After Iran Missile Attack in Jordan
US strikes Iran after American troops killed in Jordan

business.title: Pennsylvania American Water Wins Rate Increase
business.latest_developments: The Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission voted 4-1 Thursday, July 16, to grant Pennsylvania American Water a $74.9 million overall annual revenue increase, trimming the utility's original request and ordering new customer-service and consumer-protection measures.
business.summary: Pennsylvania American Water, the state's largest investor-owned water and wastewater utility, sought higher rates; the commission approved the added $74.9 million in yearly revenue and attached service and consumer-protection conditions, raising bills across its Pennsylvania service territory.

sources.title: PUC approves modified rate change for Pennsylvania American Water

around_town.title: New Commercial Street Bridge Slides Into Place
around_town.latest_developments: PennDOT's contractor began the lateral slide of the new I-376 Commercial Street Bridge around 10 a.m. Sunday, July 19, pushing the prebuilt span 102 feet into position on 42 hydraulic skids between the Squirrel Hill Tunnel and the Edgewood-Swissvale exit.
around_town.summary: The Parkway East stays closed through August 3 while crews replace the Commercial Street Bridge; PennDOT imploded the old span earlier in the week and now skids the new 22-million-pound structure into place, forcing detours for thousands of drivers.

sources.title: New Parkway East bridge being slid into place, PennDOT says
New Commercial Street Bridge on the Parkway East begins sliding into place on Sunday
Crews start sliding new Commercial Street Bridge into place

around_town.title: Fetterman's Small-Dollar Donors Dry Up
around_town.latest_developments: A Post-Gazette review of fundraising found the once-formidable small-dollar donor base of Senator John Fetterman has collapsed, the latest sign of his strained standing with Democrats over his support for Israel.
around_town.summary: Fetterman, the Pennsylvania Democrat elected to the Senate in 2022, has drawn party backlash for backing Israel and breaking with the left, and his grassroots online fundraising has thinned sharply as he heads into a difficult stretch with the base.

sources.title: Sen. John Fetterman's small-dollar donor base dries up in another sign of his struggles with Democrats

around_town.title: Smoke Returns, Code Orange for Southwestern Pa.
around_town.latest_developments: A thinner plume of Canadian wildfire smoke pushed the region back to a Code Orange air-quality alert Sunday, July 19, days after storms scrubbed out last week's hazardous Code Purple haze.
around_town.summary: The Pennsylvania Department of Environmental Protection rated air quality Code Orange, unhealthy for sensitive groups, across southwestern Pennsylvania as smoke drifted over Pittsburgh, though skies continued clearing through the afternoon into the upper 70s.

sources.title: Code Orange Air Quality Alert issued for Southwestern Pa.
Code Orange air alert issued, but skies continue to clear

around_teams.title: Harmon's Pass-Rush Upside at Steelers Camp
around_teams.latest_developments: A Post-Gazette training-camp countdown, July 19, argued defensive lineman Derrick Harmon's untapped pass-rush ability could drive a sharp jump in his sack production this season.
around_teams.summary: The Steelers count on Harmon to strengthen their defensive front; the Post-Gazette's camp preview casts him as a disruptive interior rusher poised to break out as Pittsburgh opens training camp at Saint Vincent College in Latrobe.

sources.title: Steelers training camp countdown: Derrick Harmon's untapped potential as a pass rusher could mean a big increase in his sack production

team_usa.title: USMNT's World Cup Run, in Images
team_usa.latest_developments: As the 2026 World Cup closes with Sunday's Spain-Argentina final, ESPN published a photo time capsule of the U.S. men's national team's home-tournament run, which ended in the round of 16.
team_usa.summary: The USMNT held the country's attention for a month as co-host of the 2026 World Cup before bowing out to Belgium in the round of 16; ESPN's retrospective gathers the images U.S. Soccer will remember from the campaign.

sources.title: World Cup time capsule: Images the USMNT will remember forever
